gs-flavor.Text: The Guardian Spear is both symbol of office and peerless instrument of the Emperor's judgement.

gs-hidden-desc.Text: Internal ranged profile used by the Guardian Spear.

gs-hidden-flavor.Text: Not intended for inventory or loot.

gs-hidden-cleave-desc.Text: Internal melee profile used to select the two-handed sword cleave animation.

gs-hidden-cleave-flavor.Text: Not intended for inventory or loot.

sentinel-sword-desc.Text: A master-crafted power sword of the Adeptus Custodes.

sentinel-sword-flavor.Text: A gleaming blade fashioned for the unwavering guardians of the Golden Throne.

sentinel-power-field-desc.Text: Activates the Sentinel Sword's power field for 4 rounds. Attacks made with this weapon deal +6 additional damage. Cooldown: 5 rounds.

sentinel-power-field-buff-desc.Text: The Sentinel Sword is energised. Its attacks deal +6 additional damage.

sentinel-wave-desc.Text: Swing the Sentinel Sword to project a cutting wave of force at an enemy up to 5 cells away. The attack uses the weapon's normal damage and armour penetration. Cost: 1 AP.

gs-v1-desc.Text:
A master-crafted Custodes hybrid weapon.

• Levels: 1-9
• Bolt Burst: 3 shots
• Magazine: 9 rounds

Modifiers while equipped:
• +2 Weapon Skill
• +2 Ballistic Skill
• +2% parry chance
• +2% critical hit chance
• +5% critical damage

gs-v1-modifier-desc.Text: +2 Weapon Skill, +2 Ballistic Skill, +2% parry chance, +2% critical hit chance and +5% critical damage.

gs-v1-shot-desc.Text: Fire one precise bolt for 16-22 damage and 15% armour penetration. Magazine: 9 rounds.

gs-v1-burst-desc.Text: Fire 3 bolts, each dealing 10-14 damage with 10% armour penetration. Consumes 3 of 9 rounds.

gs-v1-cleave-desc.Text: Sweep the Guardian Spear through a wide area for 14-20 damage and 10% armour penetration.
